lineage.description: Road network geometries were digitized from multiple sources including Site Planning and Development taskforce records, UAV satellite imagery, GPS field surveys, and OpenStreetMap contributions. The resulting shapefile contains classified road infrastructure (vehicle roads, paths, footpaths, military roads, and planned routes) across all Cox's Bazar refugee camps with attributes for road type, hierarchy, priority, and camp location.
